en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 23 – Aug 29 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~492 kcal/day, a touch above the ~485 of the Aug 28 board because the dropped Saturday rest day (45) was replaced by a slightly more active Friday (93). Tuesday's deadlift day is still the biggest at 771, Wednesday's swim 709, Monday's swim 675, Thursday's hack squat 622, Sunday's front squat 572, Friday was the rest day at 93 across 5,807 steps, and today reads 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 705 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −906 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Tuesday alone implies ≈ −1,185, Wednesday ≈ −1,123, Monday ≈ −1,089, Thursday ≈ −1,036 and Sunday ≈ −986; Friday's rest day still implies ≈ −507 on these assumptions.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: The five-day block closed with a clean rest day
en.i1: The window now runs Sunday to Saturday and the shape is five on, then off. Same five sessions as the Aug 28 board — 6h 04m, 35,237 kg, ~3,592 active kcal — but Friday is now inside the frame as a genuine rest day: no activity, 93 active kcal, 5,807 steps, max HR 98. Yesterday's board offered a swim or a rest day and you took the rest day, which was the option it flagged for heavy legs. Nothing is logged yet today. Thursday's hack squat day remains the single biggest piece of lifting here: 85 minutes, 19 sets, 201 reps, 15,762 kg, more tonnage than the front squat and deadlift days combined. Tuesday still holds the highest session effort at 47 (82 minutes, avg HR 123), with Wednesday's swim at 42 and Thursday at 41 behind it. The two swims stay the steady element — 2,225 m and 2,200 m, 59 and 64 minutes, avg HR 131 and 133 — and Wednesday's 10×100 + 10×50 was the sharper of the pair at max HR 165 and 784 active kcal, the highest burn of any session.
en.i2t: Both tracked lifts got a day older and neither is close to overdue by accident
en.i2: No new tracked lift entered the per-set HR chart this refresh, so the two gaps just grew. Goblet squat is 79 days from Jun 11 and is the oldest hole on the board by nine days. Trap-bar deadlift is 70 days from Jun 20. The last four points on the chart are all hack squat and all four carry the uncertain flag, including Aug 20 at 160 kg and Aug 27 at 170 kg — the chart has not had a confident reading since Jun 20, which is what makes the goblet squat worth more than its tonnage. It is also the cheapest of the three to run: four working sets at 48 kg, clean HR block, roughly 20 minutes of the session. Today is the natural slot. The trap bar is the one to hold — you hinged with the barbell on Tuesday, and a barbell deadlift plus a trap-bar day inside eight days is exactly how that pattern got dropped last time; Tuesday next week clears that window.
en.i3t: Data quality: complete for the first time in a week
en.i3: Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced at the start of this refresh, and for once there is nothing missing on the training side. Hevy holds full set-by-set data with RPE for all three lifting days, so 9,335 kg, 10,140 kg and 15,762 kg are measured rather than estimated. Friday's rest day is real and not a sync gap — Garmin recorded the full day at 93 active kcal, 5,807 steps and max HR 98, with no activity file. The board also published on consecutive days this time, unlike the Aug 26 → Aug 28 jump. The one permanent gap is still in sleep: the Aug 23 and Aug 24 calendar dates never recorded, so the Saturday-evening and Sunday-evening nights do not exist and the sleep chart visibly jumps from Friday 21 to Monday 24. Every night from Monday on is captured.
en.i4t: Recovery: the rest day did not buy a better night
en.i4: This is the number that matters this morning. You trained nothing yesterday and slept worse than you did after the heaviest lifting day of the block: 73 on 6h 16m against 79 on 6h 27m. The shortfall is not load. You woke six times against three, spent 42 minutes awake — the most of any night here — and efficiency fell to 90%, the worst of the seven and the only night this week under 91. Bedtime is the visible driver: 23:08, 23:34, 23:39, 23:46, four nights walking later while wake stays pinned between 06:12 and 06:44. Deep sleep held up at 1h 02m and 16%, the one component Garmin graded good; REM took the cost at 51 minutes and 14%, second-thinnest of the seven. Autonomics softened without breaking — HRV 36, three under both last night and the seven-night average; RHR up one to 55; overnight stress 19 against 16; Body Battery charged 53 against 58. Readiness 71, fair. Read together: one fragmented night, not accumulating fatigue, and no training reason behind it.
en.rec: Goblet squat today. You banked the rest day yesterday, the five-day block is closed, and readiness at 71 is enough for a controlled lift even if it is not enough for a session you need to be sharp for — the goblet squat is exactly that kind of session. At 79 days it is the oldest gap on the board, it is the cheapest of the three tracked lifts to run, and it would give the per-set HR chart its first confident point since Jun 20, which matters because the last four points are all estimates. Four working sets at 48 kg, keep the rest intervals even so the HR block is readable, and log every set with RPE the way Thursday was logged. If you would rather swim, take the 2,200 m template instead and move the goblet squat to Sunday — but do not let it slide past this weekend again. Hold the trap bar until Tuesday: you hinged with the barbell on Aug 25, and stacking a trap-bar day inside eight days of that is how the pattern got abandoned last time. On recovery there is exactly one lever and it is not training. Your wake time is already fixed near 06:30; your bedtime has walked from 23:08 to 23:46 across four nights and last night cost you six awakenings and the worst sleep efficiency of the week. Lights out by 22:45 tonight and the rest of this board takes care of itself. Next: goblet squat today (or swim and shift it to Sunday), trap bar Tuesday, log every set with RPE, lights out by 22:45.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 23.–29.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~492 kcal/dan, malo iznad ~485 s ploče od 28.8. jer je ispalu subotu odmora (45) zamijenio nešto aktivniji petak (93). Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja i dalje je najveći sa 771, srijedino plivanje 709, ponedjeljkovo 675, četvrtkov hack čučanj 622, nedjeljni prednji čučanj 572, petak je bio dan odmora sa 93 uz 5.807 koraka, a danas piše 0 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 705 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −906 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, a ne mjerena. Sam utorak implicira ≈ −1.185, srijeda ≈ −1.123, ponedjeljak ≈ −1.089, četvrtak ≈ −1.036 i nedjelja ≈ −986; petkov dan odmora uz iste pretpostavke i dalje implicira ≈ −507.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Blok od pet dana zatvoren je čistim danom odmora
hr.i1: Prozor sada ide od nedjelje do subote, a oblik je pet dana rada pa odmor. Istih pet treninga kao na ploči od 28.8. — 6h 04m, 35.237 kg, ~3.592 aktivnih kcal — ali petak je sada unutar okvira kao pravi dan odmora: bez aktivnosti, 93 aktivne kcal, 5.807 koraka, maksimalni puls 98. Jučerašnja ploča nudila je plivanje ili dan odmora i uzeo si odmor, opciju koju je označila za teške noge. Danas još ništa nije zabilježeno. Četvrtkov dan hack čučnja ostaje najveći pojedinačni dio dizanja ovdje: 85 minuta, 19 serija, 201 ponavljanje, 15.762 kg, više tonaže nego dani prednjeg čučnja i mrtvog dizanja zajedno. Utorak i dalje drži najviši napor treninga, 47 (82 minute, prosječni puls 123), a iza njega su srijedino plivanje sa 42 i četvrtak sa 41. Dva plivanja ostaju stabilan element — 2.225 m i 2.200 m, 59 i 64 minute, prosječni puls 131 i 133 — a srijedin 10×100 + 10×50 bio je oštriji od dvojice, maksimalni puls 165 i 784 aktivne kcal, najveća potrošnja bilo kojeg treninga.
hr.i2t: Oba praćena pokreta postala su dan starija i nijedan nije slučajno prekoračen
hr.i2: Nijedan novi praćeni pokret nije ušao u graf pulsa po serijama u ovom osvježavanju, pa su obje pauze samo narasle. Goblet čučanj stoji na 79 dana od 11.6. i najstarija je rupa na ploči, za devet dana starija od sljedeće. Mrtvo dizanje s trap barom je na 70 dana od 20.6. Zadnje četiri točke na grafu sve su hack čučanj i sve četiri nose oznaku nesigurnosti, uključujući 20.8. na 160 kg i 27.8. na 170 kg — graf nije imao pouzdano očitanje od 20.6., i upravo zato goblet čučanj vrijedi više od svoje tonaže. Ujedno je najjeftiniji od tri za izvesti: četiri radne serije na 48 kg, čist blok pulsa, otprilike 20 minuta treninga. Danas je prirodan termin. Trap bar je onaj koji treba zadržati — pregib si sa šipkom radio u utorak, a mrtvo dizanje sa šipkom plus dan s trap barom unutar osam dana upravo je način na koji je taj obrazac zadnji put napušten; utorak idući tjedan čisti taj prozor.
hr.i3t: Kvaliteta podataka: prvi put u tjedan dana potpuna
hr.i3: Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su na početku ovog osvježavanja i na strani treninga po prvi put ništa ne nedostaje. Hevy ima potpune podatke po serijama s RPE-om za sva tri dana dizanja, pa su 9.335 kg, 10.140 kg i 15.762 kg izmjereni, a ne procijenjeni. Petkov dan odmora je stvaran, a ne rupa u sinkronizaciji — Garmin je zabilježio cijeli dan sa 93 aktivne kcal, 5.807 koraka i maksimalnim pulsom 98, bez ijedne datoteke aktivnosti. Ploča je ovaj put objavljena i dva dana zaredom, za razliku od skoka s 26.8. na 28.8. Jedina trajna praznina i dalje je u snu: kalendarski datumi 23.8. i 24.8. nikad nisu zabilježeni, pa noći od subote i nedjelje navečer ne postoje i graf sna vidljivo preskače s petka 21. na ponedjeljak 24. Svaka noć od ponedjeljka nadalje je zabilježena.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: dan odmora nije kupio bolju noć
hr.i4: Ovo je broj koji jutros nešto znači. Jučer nisi trenirao ništa i spavao si lošije nego nakon najtežeg dana dizanja u bloku: 73 uz 6h 16m naspram 79 uz 6h 27m. Manjak nije u opterećenju. Budio si se šest puta naspram tri, proveo 42 minute budan — najviše od svih noći ovdje — a učinkovitost je pala na 90%, najlošija od sedam i jedina noć ovaj tjedan ispod 91. Lijeganje je vidljivi pokretač: 23:08, 23:34, 23:39, 23:46, četiri noći koje kasne dok buđenje ostaje prikovano između 06:12 i 06:44. Duboki san izdržao je na 1h 02m i 16%, jedina komponenta koju je Garmin ocijenio dobrom; REM je platio cijenu sa 51 minutom i 14%, drugi najtanji udio od sedam. Autonomika je popustila, ali nije pukla — HRV 36, tri ispod i sinoćnjeg i sedmodnevnog prosjeka; RHR viši za jedan, na 55; noćni stres 19 naspram 16; Body Battery napunio se 53 naspram 58. Spremnost 71, solidna. Zajedno pročitano: jedna isprekidana noć, a ne nakupljeni umor, i bez ijednog razloga u treningu.
hr.rec: Danas goblet čučanj. Dan odmora si jučer spremio u banku, blok od pet dana je zatvoren, a spremnost od 71 dovoljna je za kontrolirano dizanje čak i ako nije dovoljna za trening u kojem moraš biti oštar — goblet čučanj je točno takav trening. Sa 79 dana to je najstarija pauza na ploči, najjeftiniji je od tri praćena pokreta i dao bi grafu pulsa po serijama prvu sigurnu točku od 20.6., što je važno jer su zadnje četiri točke sve procjene. Četiri radne serije na 48 kg, drži pauze ujednačene da blok pulsa bude čitljiv i bilježi svaku seriju s RPE-om kako si bilježio u četvrtak. Ako radije plivaš, uzmi predložak od 2.200 m i pomakni goblet čučanj na nedjelju — ali nemoj ga pustiti da opet preskoči vikend. Trap bar zadrži do utorka: pregib si sa šipkom radio 25.8., a slaganje dana s trap barom unutar osam dana od toga način je na koji je obrazac zadnji put napušten. Na strani oporavka postoji točno jedna poluga i nije trening. Vrijeme buđenja već ti je fiksirano oko 06:30; lijeganje ti je odšetalo s 23:08 na 23:46 kroz četiri noći i sinoć te koštalo šest buđenja i najlošiju učinkovitost sna u tjednu. Ugasi svjetlo do 22:45 večeras i ostatak ove ploče brine se sam za sebe. Sljedeće: danas goblet čučanj (ili plivanje pa ga pomakni na nedjelju), trap bar u utorak, bilježi svaku seriju s RPE-om, svjetlo gasi do 22:45.
